mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and consumer spending signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when both housing starts and consumer spending are increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is declining and the money supply is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment is rising and the unemployment rate is declining (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the consumer price index signals a decrease in inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the consumer price index is below 300 (t-test p > 0.05).
